name: Remove duplicate confirmation during board setup
description: ## Problem: In Data Root onboarding (Software Factory or Both mode), choosing "Add factory Stages and default Stage Prompts" opens the Factory setup screen, which asks again with a single "Set up Board <id>" choice before running. The second confirmation is redundant (see attachment aYRu63f7R). ## Scope: src/tui/screens/onboarding/RootOnboarding.tsx (factory step, pluginRoute to software-factory factory-setup) and src/plugins/software-factory/FactorySetupScreen.tsx. ## Acceptance: (1) From onboarding, choosing the item runs software-factory setup right away for the Board, shows Setting up… and then the list of added/kept/skipped Stages and Stage Prompts, with no extra confirmation. Errors still show through ui.error. (2) Factory setup opened from Board settings (tui.ts settings entry) keeps its "Set up Board <id>" confirmation. (3) Setup runs only once per visit (no double run on re-render). (4) docs/user-guide.md (Data Root onboarding, "when you confirm") and skills/rowbly/references/setup.md are updated if they describe a confirmation. ## Notes: Suggested approach: onboarding passes a route param such as run: true, and the screen runs setupFactory on mount when it is set. Consistent with ADR-0053 §2.4 (runs only when chosen), so no ADR change. No test required (AGENTS.md: screens and flows).
